### part(a)

```{r part(a)}
library(ggplot2)
library(splines)
library(dplyr)

bmd <- read.table("bmd.dat", header = TRUE)

bmd_male <- bmd %>% filter(gender == "male")
bmd_female <- bmd %>% filter(gender == "female")

spline_fit_male <- smooth.spline(bmd_male$age, bmd_male$spnbmd, cv = TRUE)
spline_fit_female <- smooth.spline(bmd_female$age, bmd_female$spnbmd, cv = TRUE)

cat("lambda_male:", spline_fit_male$lambda, "\n")
cat("df_male:", spline_fit_male$df, "\n")
cat("lambda_female:", spline_fit_female$lambda, "\n")
cat("df_female:", spline_fit_female$df, "\n")

age_grid <- seq(min(bmd$age), max(bmd$age), length = 200)

pred_male <- predict(spline_fit_male, age_grid)
pred_female <- predict(spline_fit_female, age_grid)

#confidence intervals
sigma_male <- sd(bmd_male$spnbmd)
sigma_female <- sd(bmd_female$spnbmd)

se_band_male <- sigma_male * sqrt(1/length(bmd_male$age))
se_band_female <- sigma_female * sqrt(1/length(bmd_female$age))

z_value <- qnorm(0.95)

plot_data <- data.frame(
  age = rep(age_grid, 2),
  fitted = c(pred_male$y, pred_female$y),
  conf_lower = c(pred_male$y - z_value * se_band_male, 
                 pred_female$y - z_value * se_band_female),
  conf_upper = c(pred_male$y + z_value * se_band_male, 
                 pred_female$y + z_value * se_band_female),
  gender = rep(c("male", "female"), each = length(age_grid))
)

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = bmd_male, aes(x = age, y = spnbmd), 
             color = "blue", size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = bmd_female, aes(x = age, y = spnbmd), 
             color = "red", size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(data = plot_data %>% filter(gender == "male"), 
            aes(x = age, y = fitted), 
            color = "blue", size = 0.7) +
  geom_line(data = plot_data %>% filter(gender == "female"), 
            aes(x = age, y = fitted), 
            color = "red", size = 0.7) +
  geom_ribbon(data = plot_data %>% filter(gender == "male"), 
              aes(x = age, ymin = conf_lower, ymax = conf_upper),
              alpha = 0.2, fill = "lightblue") +
  geom_ribbon(data = plot_data %>% filter(gender == "female"), 
              aes(x = age, ymin = conf_lower, ymax = conf_upper),
              alpha = 0.2, fill = "pink") +
  labs(title = "Cubic Smoothing Spline Fit for Spinal BMD by Gender",
       x = "Age",
       y = "Relative Spinal BMD") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### part(b)
```{r part(b)}
library(MASS)

create_basis <- function(x, df = 10) {
  ns(x, df = df)
}

bayesian_smooth <- function(x, y, x_pred, df = 12, tau = 1, sigma2 = NULL) {

  H <- create_basis(x, df = df)
  H_pred <- create_basis(x_pred, df = df)
  
  # prior matrix
  Sigma_prior <- diag(df)
  if (is.null(sigma2)) {
    lm_fit <- lm(y ~ H - 1)
    sigma2 <- summary(lm_fit)$sigma^2
  }
  
  # protestor
  I <- diag(ncol(H))
  posterior_cov <- solve(t(H) %*% H + (sigma2/tau) * solve(Sigma_prior)) * sigma2
  posterior_mean <- posterior_cov %*% t(H) %*% y / sigma2
  
  mu_pred <- H_pred %*% posterior_mean
  mu_cov <- H_pred %*% posterior_cov %*% t(H_pred)
  
  return(list(
    mu_pred = as.numeric(mu_pred),
    mu_se = sqrt(diag(mu_cov)),
    posterior_mean = posterior_mean,
    posterior_cov = posterior_cov
  ))
}

# bayes method
age_grid <- seq(min(bmd$age), max(bmd$age), length = 200)

bayes_male <- bayesian_smooth(bmd_male$age, bmd_male$spnbmd, age_grid, df = 6, tau = 1)
bayes_female <- bayesian_smooth(bmd_female$age, bmd_female$spnbmd, age_grid, df = 8, tau = 1)

# 90% credible intervals
z_value <- qnorm(0.95)
bayes_conf_lower_male <- bayes_male$mu_pred - z_value * bayes_male$mu_se 
bayes_conf_upper_male <- bayes_male$mu_pred + z_value * bayes_male$mu_se 
bayes_conf_lower_female <- bayes_female$mu_pred - z_value * bayes_female$mu_se 
bayes_conf_upper_female <- bayes_female$mu_pred + z_value * bayes_female$mu_se 

spline_fit_male <- smooth.spline(bmd_male$age, bmd_male$spnbmd, cv = TRUE)
spline_fit_female <- smooth.spline(bmd_female$age, bmd_female$spnbmd, cv = TRUE)

pred_male <- predict(spline_fit_male, age_grid)
pred_female <- predict(spline_fit_female, age_grid)


residuals_male <- bmd_male$spnbmd - predict(spline_fit_male, bmd_male$age)$y
residuals_female <- bmd_female$spnbmd - predict(spline_fit_female, bmd_female$age)$y

sigma_male <- sd(residuals_male)
sigma_female <- sd(residuals_female)

se_band_male <- sigma_male 
se_band_female <- sigma_female 

freq_conf_lower_male <- pred_male$y - z_value * se_band_male 
freq_conf_upper_male <- pred_male$y + z_value * se_band_male 
freq_conf_lower_female <- pred_female$y - z_value * se_band_female 
freq_conf_upper_female <- pred_female$y + z_value * se_band_female


comparison_data <- data.frame(
  age = rep(age_grid, 4),
  method = rep(rep(c("Bayesian", "Frequentist"), each = length(age_grid)), 2),
  gender = rep(c("male", "female"), each = 2 * length(age_grid)),
  fitted = c(bayes_male$mu_pred, pred_male$y, bayes_female$mu_pred, pred_female$y),
  conf_lower = c(bayes_conf_lower_male, freq_conf_lower_male, 
                 bayes_conf_lower_female, freq_conf_lower_female),
  conf_upper = c(bayes_conf_upper_male, freq_conf_upper_male, 
                 bayes_conf_upper_female, freq_conf_upper_female)
)

p_comparison <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = bmd_male, aes(x = age, y = spnbmd), 
             color = "blue", size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = bmd_female, aes(x = age, y = spnbmd), 
             color = "red", size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = comparison_data %>% filter(method == "Bayesian"), 
            aes(x = age, y = fitted, color = gender, linetype = method), 
            linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_ribbon(data = comparison_data %>% filter(method == "Bayesian"), 
              aes(x = age, ymin = conf_lower, ymax = conf_upper, fill = gender),
              alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = comparison_data %>% filter(method == "Frequentist"), 
            aes(x = age, y = fitted, color = gender, linetype = method), 
            linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("male" = "blue", "female" = "red")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("male" = "lightblue", "female" = "pink")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Bayesian" = "solid", "Frequentist" = "dashed")) +
  labs(title = "Comparison of Bayesian and Frequentist Smoothing Methods",
       x = "Age (years)",
       y = "Relative Spinal BMD") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(p_comparison)
```

### part(c)
```{r part(c)}
create_basis <- function(x, df = 10) {
  ns(x, df = df)
}

bayesian_smooth <- function(x, y, x_pred, df = 10, tau = 1, sigma2 = NULL) {
  H <- create_basis(x, df = df)
  H_pred <- create_basis(x_pred, df = df)
  
  Sigma_prior <- diag(df)
  if (is.null(sigma2)) {
    lm_fit <- lm(y ~ H - 1)
    sigma2 <- summary(lm_fit)$sigma^2
  }
  
  # protestor
  I <- diag(ncol(H))
  posterior_cov <- solve(t(H) %*% H + (sigma2/tau) * solve(Sigma_prior)) * sigma2
  posterior_mean <- posterior_cov %*% t(H) %*% y / sigma2
  
  # predict values
  mu_pred <- H_pred %*% posterior_mean
  
  return(as.numeric(mu_pred))
}
bootstrap_fits <- function(x, y, x_pred, n_bootstrap = 100, df = 10, tau = 1) {
  n <- length(x)
  bootstrap_fits <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(x_pred), ncol = n_bootstrap)
  
  # bootstrap  
  for (i in 1:n_bootstrap) {
    bootstrap_indices <- sample(1:n, n, replace = TRUE)
    x_boot <- x[bootstrap_indices]
    y_boot <- y[bootstrap_indices]
    
    tryCatch({
      bootstrap_fits[, i] <- bayesian_smooth(x_boot, y_boot, x_pred, df = df, tau = tau)
    }, error = function(e) {
      bootstrap_fits[, i] <- NA
    })
  }
  
  return(bootstrap_fits)
}

age_grid <- seq(min(bmd$age), max(bmd$age), length = 100)


set.seed(123) 
n_bootstrap <- 100
bootstrap_male <- bootstrap_fits(bmd_male$age, bmd_male$spnbmd, age_grid, n_bootstrap = n_bootstrap)
bootstrap_female <- bootstrap_fits(bmd_female$age, bmd_female$spnbmd, age_grid, n_bootstrap = n_bootstrap)

# choose 10 bootstrap spines for the plot
n_plot <- 10
selected_indices <- sample(1:n_bootstrap, n_plot)

bootstrap_data <- data.frame(
  age = rep(age_grid, n_plot * 2),
  value = c(
    as.vector(bootstrap_male[, selected_indices]),
    as.vector(bootstrap_female[, selected_indices])
  ),
  replicate = rep(rep(1:n_plot, each = length(age_grid)), 2),
  gender = rep(c("male", "female"), each = length(age_grid) * n_plot)
)

original_male <- bayesian_smooth(bmd_male$age, bmd_male$spnbmd, age_grid)
original_female <- bayesian_smooth(bmd_female$age, bmd_female$spnbmd, age_grid)

original_data <- data.frame(
  age = rep(age_grid, 2),
  value = c(original_male, original_female),
  gender = rep(c("male", "female"), each = length(age_grid))
)

p_bootstrap <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = bmd, aes(x = age, y = spnbmd, color = gender), 
             size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(data = bootstrap_data, 
            aes(x = age, y = value, group = interaction(gender, replicate), 
                color = gender),
            alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(data = original_data, 
            aes(x = age, y = value, color = gender),
            linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("male" = "blue", "female" = "red")) +
  labs(title = paste("Bootstrap Replicates of Fitted Curves (", n_plot, " of ", n_bootstrap, " shown)", sep=""),
       x = "Age (years)",
       y = "Relative Spinal BMD") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(p_bootstrap)
```
